chatHistory.text:
Here is what I am starting with.

Starting request:
Introduction to Computer Science with Python, a 15-lesson introductory college course with weekly autograded quizzes and hands-on coding labs. Lessons cover: orientation and environment setup; variables, expressions, and types; conditionals and boolean logic; while loops; for loops and range; functions and scope; lists; strings and text processing; dictionaries and nested data; file input and output; a midterm review and midterm exam; recursion; classes and objects; debugging and testing; an introduction to algorithms; and a final project integrating the full semester.
Got it. I will keep using that starting request while we build, check, and revise the course package.

observations.observation: Lesson 1's first objective ("Trace Python code using orientation and explain the output before runn…") has no clear echo in its assessments.
observations.whyItMatters: An objective nothing assesses is a promise the gradebook never checks.

prompts.label: Trace it
prompts.prompt: Trace Lesson 1's first objective through the quiz, rubric, and assignment. Where does the chain break?

prompts.label: Propose coverage
prompts.prompt: Propose assessment items that would cover Lesson 1's first objective, as options.

promptText: Introduction to Computer Science with Python, a 15-lesson introductory college course with weekly autograded quizzes and hands-on coding labs. Lessons cover: orientation and environment setup; variables, expressions, and types; conditionals and boolean logic; while loops; for loops and range; functions and scope; lists; strings and text processing; dictionaries and nested data; file input and output; a midterm review and midterm exam; recursion; classes and objects; debugging and testing; an introduction to algorithms; and a final project integrating the full semester.
